purpose: Map and prototype referral-status tracking workflow
intended_outcomes: Make delayed referrals visible to authorised operators while preserving clinical decision boundaries.
non_goals: Making clinical, privacy, or legal determinations
Ingesting or cleaning unverified external spreadsheets or data assets
data_boundary: Generated records only; no customer or personal information.

decision_rights.decision: Clinical safety controls and patient-safety thresholds
Synthetic technical prototyping and metric generation

escalation_paths.topic: Unverified facilitator datasets or file ingestion requests
Sponsor demands for engineering policy approval or clinical flow priority disputes
